final: WITH country_counts AS (SELECT p.death_country, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM batting AS b JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id COLLATE BINARY = b.player_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY p.death_country), totals AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM country_counts), shares AS (SELECT c.death_country, c.record_count, 1.0 * c.record_count / t.total_count AS share FROM country_counts AS c JOIN totals AS t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL), averages AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT s.death_country, s.record_count, s.share, s.share - a.average_share FROM shares AS s JOIN averages AS a ON a.average_share IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > a.average_share
